# WhisPaste

> WhisPaste is an MIT-licensed voice-input tool for Windows, macOS, and Linux that transcribes speech locally and inserts the transcript at the cursor position of the active application. Two on-device engines are available: whisper.cpp (99 languages, GPU-accelerated) and Parakeet via sherpa-onnx (~25 languages, CPU-only but several times faster than whisper.cpp on the same hardware). It is a desktop-only app; iOS and Android are not planned.

## Download

- [Download (Deutsch)](https://whispaste.de/download/): Microsoft Store, DMG für macOS, oder kostenlos von GitHub
- [Download (English)](https://whispaste.de/en/download/): Microsoft Store, macOS DMG, or free from GitHub

## Privacy

- [Datenschutz (Deutsch)](https://whispaste.de/datenschutz/): Audio bleibt lokal; optionales opt-in für Cloud-Provider
- [Privacy (English)](https://whispaste.de/en/privacy/): Audio stays local; cloud providers are opt-in

## Use Cases

- [Anwendungsfälle (Deutsch)](https://whispaste.de/use-cases/): Spracheingabe für Entwickler, Studierende und den Schreib-Alltag — direkt am Cursor in jeder App
- [Use cases (English)](https://whispaste.de/en/use-cases/): Voice input for developers, students, and everyday writing — straight at the cursor in any app
